content.rendered:
Elementary Summer Learning Academy

Limited space is available in this year’s foundational reading support and reinforcement classes.

This two week (10-day) program, taught by Sherwood teachers, is intended to serve our elementary students who would benefit from targeted support in the areas of reading and writing in a fun, more relaxed school setting.  The reading skills development classes will be offered to any current Kindergarten-4th grade student who does not yet demonstrate reading proficiency at his or her grade level. Lessons will reinforce students’ knowledge while preparing them for the next step in their reading journey.

This class is intended for students who are not yet or have just begun to read at their current grade level. These classes are not appropriate for students who are currently reading at or above grade level.

Space is currently available for incoming 2nd graders. All other classes are waitlist only.

If you would like to register, please click the link below or contact Nanci Stauffer at nstauffer@sherwood.k12.or.us to be placed on a waiting list for all other grades.

Date: August 4th-15th (Monday-Friday)

Time: 8:00am-11:00am

Location: Hawks View Elementary

Cost: $275.00

Incoming 2nd Grade Registration Form

Moving to the Middle Transition Class

Current 5th Graders

If your 5th grader is a little nervous about moving on to middle school, this is the summer class for them. Teachers from Sherwood Middle School we help will ease their fears regarding lockers, transitioning between classes, organization, and the new responsibilities that come with being a new middle schooler. Students will have a great time as they meet classmates from other elementary schools, tour the campus, and get a sneak peek of Outdoor School.  

This class is limited to current 5th grade students only.

Six different 4-day sessions will be offered:  

August 4-7 (Monday-Thursday)                             August 11-14 (Monday-Thursday)

8-9:50am or 10-11:50am or Noon-1:50pm          8-9:50am or 10-11:50am or Noon-1:50pm     

Once a session is full, registration will be closed for that session and students will need to register for an alternative date.  

Location:  Sherwood Middle School – Activity Entrance

Cost: $85 – Limited needs based scholarships are available.

Registration opens soon

Once a session is full, families will need to register for a different session. Please contact the program coordinator at nstauffer@sherwood.k12.or.us if interested in having your child placed on a waitlist.

Session 1: August 4-August 7 – 8:00am-9:50am

Session 2: August 4-August 7- 10:00am-11:50am

Session 3: August 4-August 7 – Noon-1:50pm

Session 4: August 11-August 14 – 8:00am-9:50am

Session 5: August 11-August 14 – 10:00am-11:50am

Session 6: August 11-August 14 – Noon-1:50pm

Summer Programs in Oregon

Many colleges and organizations in Oregon offer summer camps and programs. A variety of options may be found here.
